intake.label: (Consult Us)
intake.heading: Tell us how we can assist with your legal matter, and we will connect you with the right lawyer for your case.
intake.intro: Share a few details about your matter and preferred consultation arrangements. Our team will review your request in confidence, complete the necessary conflict checks, and contact you regarding the appropriate next step. Submitting this form does not confirm an appointment or establish a lawyer-client relationship.

intake-client.title: Client type
intake-client.text: Whether you’re coming to us yourself or for a business.

intake-personal.title: Personal information
intake-personal.text: As on your national ID or passport, so we can run a conflict check before we speak.

intake-company.title: Company information
intake-company.text: The business you represent, as on its commercial registry. Optional if you’re coming to us yourself.

intake-engagement.title: Type of engagement
intake-engagement.text: How you’d like to work with us. We can change this together later.

intake-practice.title: Practice area
intake-practice.text: Choose every area your matter touches.

intake-matter.title: About the matter
intake-matter.text: What happened, who is involved and any dates or deadlines. Attach documents if you have them.

intake-payment.title: Fees & payment
intake-payment.text: How you’d prefer to pay. Fees are agreed in your engagement letter.

intake.documentsHint: PDF, Word or images, up to 10MB in all
intake.consent: I confirm the details above are accurate. I understand the firm keeps them confidential, and that sending this form doesn’t by itself make the firm my lawyers.

errors.practice: Choose at least one practice area.
errors.choose: Please choose one of the options.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.consent: Please tick this box to continue.

intake.sentHeading: Thank you, {name}. Your request is with us, and a partner will be in touch within two working days.
intake.reference: Your reference is {reference}. Keep it to hand if you call or write to us about this matter.

nextSteps.title: Review
nextSteps.text: A partner reads your request and checks it for conflicts of interest.

nextSteps.title: Call
nextSteps.text: We call you within two working days to talk the matter through.

nextSteps.title: Engagement letter
nextSteps.text: If we take the matter on, you receive a letter setting out its scope and fees.
